messages:
amanda: Quick heads-up — I noticed the API reference shows the request-id as a JSON field in the examples for /v1/generate, but the OpenAPI spec lists it as a header (`in: header`). That causes confusion for SDK snippet generators and the curl example.
kevin: ah ok, can you paste the two snippets so I can see the mismatch?
amanda: sure — curl example currently in the page:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-2-mini","prompt":"hello","request_id":"abc-123"}'
```
but the OpenAPI fragment in the docs JSON/YAML shows:
```yaml
parameters:
  - name: X-Request-Id
    in: header
    required: false
    schema:
      type: string
```
kevin: yep that's the mismatch. The canonical runtime expects `X-Request-Id` header (and we lowecase to `x-request-id` in nginx), but some doc examples used `request_id` in the body to make quick demos. We should standardize on header.
lucas: +1 for header. Also we should show both curl and python-sdk examples so folks know how to pass it. Python SDK currently has `client.generate(..., request_id=\"...\")` — that's a convenience param that maps to the header. We should keep the SDK snippet but add a note mapping it to the header.
sarah_p: Agreed. For the OpenAPI change: we should add an example value for the header and update the example request bodies that mistakenly include `request_id`. That will also fix the generated sample server code.
jordan: I can open a small docs PR to: 1) remove `request_id` from example bodies, 2) add `X-Request-Id` header examples across generate/stream/rerank, and 3) add a short note in the SDK snippets that `request_id` param sets the header. Any objections?
amanda: sounds good. One extra ask — include a one-liner about why it's a header (propagation across proxies and tracing). Keeps it clear for infra folks.
kevin: +1. Also add a tiny example for batching: make clear header should be per-client-request not per-batched-item.
jordan: cool — I'll open PR rwd/docs#5432 with the changes. tagging reviewers: @amanda @kevin @sarah_p.
docs-bot: New PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5432 — CI: docs build passed, linkcheck failed for one anchor (will fix in same PR).
amanda: thanks. I'll review by EOD. if anyone sees other endpoints with body `request_id` examples, drop them here and i'll add to the PR checklist. :thumbsup:
lucas: I spotted the same pattern in the rerank example earlier — looks like a copy/paste. I'll send the file path in a sec.
sarah_p: also check the Go and JS SDK snippets — parity note is helpful so we don't duplicate wrong examples in multiple languages.
jordan: noted. planning to push an update in a few hours. no rollout risk, doc-only.
kevin: thanks — after Amanda merges, I'll follow up with a small patch to the sample generator so it emits header-based examples by default.
amanda: perfect. closing loop here — thanks everyone!
